title: Santa Cruz: a fast-growing city and its farmland
goal: Describe Santa Cruz and its agribusiness, contrasting the benefits and the problems with sin embargo, no obstante and aunque.
grammar: contrast and concession connectors like sin embargo and no obstante

items: I can contrast two ideas about Santa Cruz with *sin embargo*, *no obstante* and *aunque*.
I can say what Santa Cruz produces and what worries some people.
I can name the main words for farming, forest clearing and fires in Spanish.
